macros.name: papergraduate
macros.doc: When used outside of a pgfpicture, \papergraduate alone draws a graduated paper as a wallpaper on the current page background (on this page with x = 1in and y = 1in).

macros.name: usetikz
macros.doc: \usetikz is a facility provided to load pgf, tikz, pgf-modules, and tikz-libraries, without the need to know if you must use \usepackage or \usepgfmodule or \usetikzlibrary.
